name: kopai
description: Kopai plugins for Claude: on-call triage over OpenTelemetry data, and instrumentation and dashboard tooling.

plugins.name: kopai-oncall
plugins.description: Put Claude on call with Kopai: triage alerts from your OpenTelemetry traces, logs and metrics, verify fixes against baseline, and write sitreps, handoffs and status reports. Read-only by design.

plugins.name: kopai-dev
plugins.description: Instrument apps with OpenTelemetry, validate the telemetry against Kopai, and build Kopai dashboards.
